resumeText:
Vikram Singh Chauhan | Lucknow | vikram.chauhan@example.com | +91 94150 88xxx

EDUCATION
BBA (Banking and Finance), Amity University, Lucknow (2023 - 2026) | CGPA 7.4/10
Class XII (Commerce), City Montessori School, Lucknow (2023) | 81%

INTERNSHIPS
Sales Intern, Griha Housing Finance, Lucknow branch (May 2025 - July 2025, 8 weeks)
- Went with the sales officer to builder sites and customer homes to explain home loan offers.
- Collected PAN, Aadhaar, salary slips and bank statements and checked them against the application form.
- Arranged loan file documents in the branch checklist order before credit review.
- Worked out rough eligibility from net salary and existing EMIs using the branch FOIR sheet.

Marketing Intern, Awadh Realtors, Lucknow (December 2024 - January 2025, 6 weeks)
- Called walk-in enquiries from a property expo to fix site visits.

PROJECTS
Home Loan vs Loan Against Property (semester project, 2025)
- Compared interest rates, tenure and processing fees of home loans and loan against property from six lenders.

Financial Literacy Survey (group project, 2024)
- Surveyed 80 salaried people in Lucknow about EMIs and credit scores.

COURSEWORK
Banking Operations, Retail Lending, Principles of Marketing, Business Communication

SKILLS
MS Excel, EMI calculation, CIBIL score basics, Hindi, English, two-wheeler with licence

ACTIVITIES
Organised a blood donation camp with the NSS unit, speaking to 150 donors on the day.
College cricket team
